create_llama_model: create a LlamaForCausalLM model from a HuggingFace LlamaConfig for inference
build_decoder_layer: build a LlamaDecoderLayer with attention, MLP, and RMSNorm for a transformer block
load_model_weights: load HuggingFace checkpoint weights into a LlamaForCausalLM with tensor parallel support
run_model_forward: run a forward pass on LlamaForCausalLM with input_ids, positions, and forward batch info
split_prefill_forward: split a prefill forward pass across decoder layers with configurable layer intervals
